question: Across Artificial Intelligence and Software Engineering, what research does 'Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks' describe, and what research does 'Data Observability and Quality Gates for Production RAG Systems' describe? Present both contributions with their respective fields.
ground_truth:
Artificial Intelligence — Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly improves large language model accuracy by grounding responses in retrieved passages. We explore agentic multi-hop reasoning and routing across heterogeneous vector indices.
Software Engineering — Data Observability and Quality Gates for Production RAG Systems: Silent data corruption in RAG pipelines degrades LLM answer faithfulness without throwing runtime errors. We introduce automated quality gates using Great Expectations 1.x to catch stale and malformed embeddings before serving.

Databases — Mitigating Ghost Vectors in Dense Retrieval via Idempotent Indexing: Soft-deletions in vector databases leave orphaned embeddings that lead to hallucinations. This paper designs an idempotent index synchronization protocol that guarantees complete purges of outdated vector artifacts.
Data Management — Freshness SLAs for Real-Time LLM Knowledge Augmentation: We define freshness service-level agreements (SLAs) for temporal document ingestion. By tracking document age and update cadence, our orchestrator dynamically prioritizes recrawling high-churn technical corpora.
